Title: Limited Edition V:TES Anthology Set Announced for European Championships in Berlin

Messages.Author: Damnans
Messages.Body:
White Wolf “Nordic” Larps Featured on New Cards

White Wolf, Vampire: Elder Kindred Network and Participation | Design | Agency are proud to announce that the 2017 European Championship of Vampire: The Eternal Struggle will be held as an open tournament at the World of Darkness Berlin convention on the 11-14 May, 2017.

With the intent of making this event a truly unforgettable experience, White Wolf has licensed P|D|A to publish a Limited Edition 100-card V:TES Anthology Set for the World of Darkness Berlin. Each participant of the convention will receive a copy of the set as part of their registration fee, and they will have the opportunity to pre-order additional sets to be collected at the event.

The Anthology Set will consist of a selection of highly sought-after re-prints, cards from various VEKN expansions, and several new cards representing elements of the collaborative-style full immersion live-action roleplaying events End of the Line and Enlightenment in Blood, both of which will be run in Berlin during the convention. The exact contents of the card set will be announced at the end of January.

For further information on the World of Darkness Berlin convention, please visit www.worldofdarkness.berlin/.

Contact

Ginés Quiñonero, Chairman, Vampire Elder Kindred Network
email:  www.vekn.net/

For questions about the convention, please email  or www.worldofdarkness.berlin/

World of Darkness®, White Wolf® and Vampire: the Eternal Struggle® are Copyright© [2016] White Wolf Publishing AB All rights reserved.

V:EKN Website Coordinator

Messages.Author: Damnans
Messages.Body:
The reasoning behing this decision is that this way we get VTES printed again.

We are well aware that 150 EUR is a higher entry fee than normal for a Continental Championship, but the reward is likewise huge.

We cannot reveal the contents of the Anthology set until the end of January, but rest assured that they will be worth it.

V:EKN Website Coordinator

Messages.Author: BenPeal
Messages.Body:
> Hakuron wrote:
> My players would like to know the reasoning behind this decision.
>
Reasons include and are not exclusive to:

- The opportunity to get cards printed for the first time in seven years.
- The opportunity to reprint sought-after, expensive cards.
- The opportunity to print new cards and cards from VEKN sets.
- The opportunity to assemble a team that will have the experience to undertake, hopefully, future such projects.
- The opportunity to get V:TES front and center in front of White Wolf.
- The opportunity to demonstrate to White Wolf that printing V:TES is a profitable endeavor.
- If we turned down this opportunity, you would all fucking kill us.

Messages.Author: ICL
Messages.Body:
Is there a limit to how many sets are going to be printed?

Is there any reason one person couldn't order 1000 sets? Sure, the initial option for how many you want goes up to 10, but is there anything to stop someone from ordering more than 10?

If there are meaningful limits on what can be arranged for a con goer, then, sure, that limits availability significantly. If somebody, let's say a German game seller with an international online presence, can just "attend" the con and buy a 1000 sets, seems like that would make availability somewhat more common, even finding a way to navigate shipping internationally at reasonable markup for shipping, duty, taxes, whatever.

I'm actually quite interested in answers to the questions above as a number of locals are chiming in about wanting 3 sets apiece, which quickly adds up to a ... lot ... of sets.

Traveller Card Game
